selection: smallest SHA-256 ranks among valid reconstructed products within each category
category_selection: top categories by positive-label product count before metadata reconstruction unless explicitly listed
split_unit: connected product groups formed from exact cleaned-text duplicates and parent ASIN when available
positive_and_negative_labels: merge by product ID; retain explicit empty evidence lists
invalid_evidence_policy: exclude product and report the reason; no fuzzy offset repair
overlap_policy: flat BIO: prefer longer spans, then attribute name; log rejected annotations
tokenization: preserved benchmark regex with evidence-boundary splitting; gold-assisted benchmark only
sequence_length_policy: exclude whole products if any paragraph exceeds 512 subwords for either cached BERT or DeBERTa; report exclusions
evaluation: custom reproducible subset, not the original published MAVE benchmark splits
